name: Street Squad
hook: Punch through the goons. Then take down the boss.
how: Walk down the street and fight off each wave of goons together: punch three times for a combo, kick to knock them flat, jump-kick into a crowd. Clear all three areas and The Boss comes out.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD, J punch, K kick, Space jump; on touch, drag to move and tap the buttons
uses: The host's browser runs the goons, the boss and the waves; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
AI buddies fight beside you until enough people join.
Every punch, knockdown and K.O. shows up for the whole squad at once.
ideas: Add a baseball bat you can pick up and swing
Add a special move that hits everyone around you
Make the street a pirate harbor with sailor goons
